name: personal-agent-skills
handshake: Harness v7.0.0 loaded · 21 modules · 说需求，或发参考图。

modules.name: personal-identity-profile
modules.description: Persistent personal taste and artist policy for Tera-Dark's creative work. Holds preferences for structured visual design, Xiao-artist and fashion sensibilities, optional tension or unusual details when appropriate, scoped dislikes, and business goals. Current requests and locked references take priority. Does not generate prompts. Use for creative, illustration, design and aesthetic tasks or 我的风格 / 按我习惯.
modules.triggers: 我的风格, 个人偏好, 按我习惯, any creative task

modules.name: aesthetic-director-core
modules.description: Creative direction for OC, characters, illustration, fashion and key visuals. Selects task-appropriate visual relationships and reduces formulaic composition before blueprint and model compilation. Supports quiet, formal, dynamic and experimental work; odd details, narrative and elaborate comparison are optional where suitable. Use for 审美, 创意方向, 人味, 不要AI味 or weak composition.
modules.triggers: OC, 人设, 插画, 服装, 海报, 联动海报, 艺术海报, key visual, crossover poster, 审美, 创意方向, 人味, 高级感, 不要AI味, 太平淡, 太乱

modules.name: creative-skill-router
modules.description: Intent router for creative and interface requests: character and illustration design, UI/UX product design, NAI5/Anima/MOSS-Image prompts, reference analysis, feedback learning, ComfyUI and LoRA. Dispatches to the correct owner without redesigning or encoding model syntax.
modules.triggers: any request, 设计, UI, UX, 前端, 网页界面, 设计系统, 提示词, prompt, 反推, 分析, ComfyUI, LoRA, NAI5, Anima, MOSS-Image

modules.name: character-design-engine
modules.description: Turns a Creative Brief (from aesthetic-director-core) into a complete, model-agnostic character blueprint — design thesis, silhouette architecture, visual anchors, garment engineering (base / structural / signature extension / accessory system), material contrast, palette hierarchy, behavioral pose + camera, narrative residue, presentation format — then runs a subtraction pass. Use for OC, 人设, 角色设计, 服装设计, 立绘, 高定服设, 二游角色, character sheet, fashion concept. Never writes model-specific prompt syntax.
modules.triggers: OC, 人设, 角色设计, 服装设计, 立绘, 高定服设, 二游角色, character sheet, 极繁, 极繁精美, 华丽人设, 原创圈

modules.name: chatgpt-inspired-ui
modules.description: Design and audit product interfaces using an original, reusable design language inspired by publicly documented ChatGPT UI principles—calm neutral surfaces, content-first hierarchy, restrained actions, accessible controls, conversation-friendly patterns, and responsive utility layouts. Use for UI/UX, frontend, dashboards, tools, mobile web, design systems, and cross-project interface consistency; not illustration prompt generation.
modules.triggers: UI, UX, 前端, 界面, 网页设计, 组件, 工作台, 移动端, 设计系统, ChatGPT风格, GPT界面, 极简实用主义, dashboard, design system, responsive, frontend

modules.name: editorial-layout-design
modules.description: Designs graphic-editorial composition for character posters, illustrated magazine covers, zines, title cards and image-plus-type key visuals. Owns typography hierarchy, safe regions, image/text overlap, page grid and layer compositing; does not replace illustration-direction camera work, creative direction or model-specific syntax. Use when user asks 排版设计, 图文排版, 字体层级, 人物破框, 角色海报版式, 杂志封面, editorial layout, cover typography, or provides an image to study its graphic layout.
modules.triggers: 排版, 版式, 图文排版, 平面构成, 字体设计, 字体层级, 人物破框, 杂志封面, 编辑式海报, editorial, typography, magazine cover, zine, title card, poster design

modules.name: illustration-direction
modules.description: Turns a Creative Brief into an authored, model-agnostic illustration blueprint — the image thesis, captured moment, visual motif, environment-character relationship, camera and framing, scale contrast, negative space, physical light sources, density map, narrative residue, and one coherent surreal detail. Use for 插画, 氛围图, 竖屏, 半留白, 印象风, 故事感, key visual, poster, scene illustration, cinematic composition, or whenever a character needs to be placed into a designed moment rather than displayed on a plate. Never writes model-specific prompt syntax.
modules.triggers: 插画, 氛围图, 竖屏, 半留白, 印象风, 故事感, key visual, poster, scene, 极繁, 特写垫底, 大头贴, 元素贴, 角色拼贴

modules.name: japanese-cinematic-composition
modules.description: 日系电影感构图思维。通过用户提供的摄影案例研究机位、决定性瞬间、距离层次、光色与真实互动，生成 Photography Decision Sheet 交给 illustration-direction；不绑定特定摄影师、不复刻作品，也不负责模型语法。
modules.triggers: 日系电影感构图, 电影感构图, 摄影思维, 摄影脑, 摄影感, 纪实抓拍, 生活流, 观察机位, 真实镜头, NAI5电影感, cinematic composition

modules.name: small-artist-brain
modules.description: Evidence-driven Xiao-artist visual decision overlay informed by 16 ZHENG works and 12 additional user-supplied premium commission examples. Uses composition, character vitality, palette hierarchy, density, space, gesture and camera to raise illustration taste without copying works. Use for 小画师脑, 小画师审美, 米画师, 蒸蒸, ZHENG, 精美插画, 女性向视觉, 作者感, 人物活人感, 高完成度肖像, 双人互动设计, and visual taste refinement. Does not own character identity, generic aesthetic gates, renderer syntax or Danbooru tags.
modules.triggers: 小画师脑, 小画师, 米画师, 蒸蒸, ZHENG, 女性向, 作者感, 插画审美, 高定肖像, 双人活人感

modules.name: anima-renderer
modules.description: Thin Anima-specific renderer that converts a Visual Prompt Packet plus verified Danbooru tags into the established Anima Tag + Natural Language prompt. Handles only Anima syntax, tag serialization, relation wording, output modes, and final target-specific checks. Does not design.
modules.triggers: Anima, Anima prompt, Anima 提示词, Anima checkpoint

modules.name: danbooru-tag-gate
modules.description: Web-first validation boundary for Danbooru-derived hard tags shared by Anima and NAI5 plus MOSS-Image Tag-mode workflows. Resolves exact canonical tags, exact aliases, or missing without fuzzy promotion. Use whenever a prompt packet needs verified Danbooru identity.
modules.triggers: Danbooru tag, tag validation, tag check, exact tag, alias, tag verification

modules.name: general-image-prompt-adapter
modules.description: Model adapter that compiles a finished character or illustration blueprint into a natural-language image prompt for models that are not Anima or NAI5 — Midjourney, DALL-E / GPT Image, Google Imagen / Gemini image, Flux, SDXL-style checkpoints, or an unnamed target. Keeps parameters out of the prompt unless the target officially supports them, and labels every model-specific claim with an evidence level. Use when the user names any other image model, says 通用提示词, MJ, Midjourney, DALL-E, Imagen, Flux, SD, 或没说用什么模型. Does not design — if no blueprint exists, route through aesthetic-director-core first.
modules.triggers: Midjourney, MJ, DALL-E, GPT Image, Imagen, Gemini image, Nano Banana, Flux, SDXL, Stable Diffusion, 通用提示词, 其他模型, 不知道用什么模型

modules.name: moss-image-renderer
modules.description: Thin OpenMOSS MOSS-Image renderer for turning approved Visual Prompt Packets into English Caption, optional Danbooru Tag, or native JSON Layout prompts. Uses verified tags only when needed; preserves visual design; never generates images.
modules.triggers: MOSS-Image, MOSS Image, OpenMOSS, MOSS生图, moss prompt, moss tags, MOSS Layout, MOSS风格触发词

modules.name: nai5-renderer
modules.description: Thin NovelAI V5 renderer that converts a Visual Prompt Packet plus verified Danbooru tags into the user's compact NAI5 prompt format. Handles artist namespace, weighting syntax, base/character prompt fields, interaction tags, ordering, and optional targeted negatives. Does not design.
modules.triggers: NAI5, NovelAI, NAI提示词, tag prompt, Danbooru prompt, artist stack

modules.name: visual-prompt-core
modules.description: Model-agnostic prompt planning layer that converts a validated character or illustration blueprint into one compact Visual Prompt Packet shared by Anima, NAI5, MOSS-Image, and future image-model renderers. Use after design is complete and before any model-specific prompt syntax. Does not redesign the concept or emit target-model syntax.
modules.triggers: prompt packet, visual prompt, prompt core, 提示词编译, 提示词规划, NAI5, Anima, MOSS

modules.name: image-reverse-analysis
modules.description: Decomposes a reference image into transferable design language — silhouette and mass distribution, motif grammar, garment construction, material contrast, palette hierarchy, pose logic, negative space and presentation format — instead of a tag dump. Output feeds aesthetic-director-core (for original work) or a model adapter (for faithful reproduction). Use for 反推, 分析图片, 提取提示词, 还原风格, 参考这张图, reverse prompt, image analysis.
modules.triggers: 反推, 分析图片, 提取提示词, 还原风格, 参考这张, reverse prompt, reference image

modules.name: prompt-analysis
modules.description: Reviews an existing image-generation prompt by separating design intent from model syntax — what it is trying to say, which design layer is weak (thesis, silhouette, garment structure, causality, density, punctum), what is noise, and what a rewrite should change. Use for 优化提示词, 这个 prompt 哪里有问题, prompt review, 分析这段提示词, why does this prompt not work.
modules.triggers: 优化提示词, prompt 哪里有问题, prompt review, 分析这段提示词

modules.name: comfyui-workflow
modules.description: Technical placeholder for ComfyUI workflow organization, node troubleshooting, metadata and LoRA/model integration. Use when the user mentions ComfyUI, workflow json, nodes, 工作流. Does not handle design or prompt creativity.
modules.triggers: ComfyUI, workflow, nodes, 工作流

modules.name: dataset-management
modules.description: Technical placeholder for image dataset organization, caption/tag management and training preparation. Use when the user mentions dataset, 数据集, 打标, captions, 训练集. Does not handle visual design decisions.
modules.triggers: dataset, 数据集, 打标, captions, 训练集

modules.name: lora-training
modules.description: Technical placeholder for LoRA training pipelines: dataset prep, caption organization, training configuration, evaluation. Use when the user mentions LoRA, 训练, fine-tune, 炼丹. Does not decide character concepts or artistic direction.
modules.triggers: LoRA, 训练, fine-tune, 炼丹

modules.name: evaluation-loop
modules.description: Evaluates a generated image or prompt against the user's actual goal and locked facts. Separates design, model execution and technical failures, prioritizes the reported issue, and preserves approved dimensions during revision. Use for 太平淡, 太乱, 不像, 没人味, 这版可以, 评价一下, 哪里不对, or comparisons.
modules.triggers: 太平淡, 太乱, 不像, 没人味, 这版可以, 评价一下, 哪里不对, compare
